Content_EN: The spaceship's panels are shattered into four pieces...
Content_CN: 飞船的面板碎成了四块……
Name: Jack

Content_EN: I must repair them to leave this place.
Content_CN: 我必须修好它们才能离开这里。
Name: Jack

Content_EN: Those yellow crystals are glowing; they seem to be useful.
Content_CN: 那些黄色水晶在发光，看起来很有用。
Name: Jack

Content_EN: Use arrow keys or WASD to move and collect them.
Content_CN: 使用方向键或WASD移动来收集它们。
Name: Jack

Content_EN: If needed@ use the button in the upper right to refresh the current level.
Content_CN: 如果需要，可以使用右上角的按钮刷新当前关卡。
Name: Jack

Content_EN: Alternatively@ you can press the 'Z' key to undo the last move.
Content_CN: 或者，你可以按"Z"键撤销上一步操作。
Name: Jack

Content_EN: Collect all crystals to unlock the exit. Let's move on!
Content_CN: 收集所有水晶即可解锁出口。出发吧！
Name: Jack
